steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Good customer service creates competitive advantage: it builds loyalty, generates repeat business, and encourages positive word-of-mouth recommendations (free marketing). | Key Fact: Methods of delivering customer service: well-trained staff, clear returns policies, efficient complaint handling, after-sales support (warranties, helplines), personalised communication, and multichannel support (phone, email, chat, social media). | Key Fact: Monitoring customer service: customer feedback surveys, mystery shoppers, complaint analysis, online reviews, and Net Promoter Score (NPS). | Key Fact: Handling complaints effectively: listen, acknowledge, resolve quickly, and learn from the complaint to prevent recurrence. A well-handled complaint can increase customer loyalty.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two ways good customer service can benefit a business. | Describe how a business can monitor the quality of its customer service. | Evaluate whether investing in customer service training is more important than investing in marketing.
